_note: Copy of /pricing (app/pricing/page.tsx, components/pricing/*), rebuilt 2026-10-11 (lead-outreach docs/website/REBUILD_BRIEF_2026-10-11.md). OFFER (USD, one-time; lib/offer.ts): $500 per connection; 3 connections or more and one of them is free (3 for the price of 2); live in about a day once we have access (some marketplaces approve API access first). FREE TRIAL: 'your first link', two of the reader's platforms connected for 7 days, no card; keep it = those connections billed as normal ($500 each, they count toward 3 for 2); don't keep it = switched off, nothing to pay. PAYMENT: once, after it runs and before handover. AFTER HANDOVER: 90 days of fixes included, also platform API changes; then a fixed price per fix, agreed first, or any developer (the client has the code). HOSTING: the client's own cloud account, billed by the host, usually $5-20 a month; we charge nothing monthly. A connection is one platform or account we build for; whether a team tool or supplier file is priced on its own is NOT promised here (we list everything on the call, price in writing first). The example setups' totals are computed from their parts (lib/offer.ts quote()); the sentences here spell the numbers out and lib/offer.test.mts checks that they agree (every dollar amount is a price of the offer or one of the market/hosting figures listed in the test). The real client stays anonymous: no marketplace or warehouse brand names next to 'Netherlands', claim only what its build really does. Compare by category only, never name another vendor or tool. Never link the live demo or the case studies from this page (email readers only). Plain US English, short sentences, no idioms ('nothing hidden', 'pick a size', 'in step', 'counts once').

items.q: How does 3 for the price of 2 work?
items.a: Take 3 connections or more and one of them is free. 2 connections are $1,000, 3 are $1,000, 4 are $1,500 and 5 are $2,000, one-time.

items.q: What does the free trial run?
items.a: Your first link: two of your platforms, for example your store and one marketplace. It goes live in about a day once we have access. Then it runs 7 days on your real orders and stock. No card.
Keep it and those connections are billed as normal: $500 each, one-time, and they count toward 3 for the price of 2. Or tell us to stop: we switch it off and you pay nothing.

items.q: When do we pay, and how?
items.a: Once, after it runs and before handover. You get one invoice in US dollars, for the price we agreed in writing before we started. If it doesn't work, you don't pay.
90 days of fixes are included. After that, each fix has a fixed price, agreed before we start. Or any developer can work on it: you have the source code.

items.q: What if a platform changes its API?
items.a: In the first 90 days, we update your build at no charge. After that, it is a fixed price per fix, agreed first.

items.q: Where does it run, and what does hosting cost?
items.a: In your own cloud account. We set it up for you. The host bills you directly, usually $5–20 a month. We charge nothing monthly.

items.q: What access do you need to our accounts?
items.a: API keys that you create in your own accounts, limited to what the build needs. You can revoke them any time. We don't ask for passwords.
Yes. You get the full source code with the build. It is yours to keep, run and change. No license to renew.

items.q: Why one payment and not a monthly fee?
items.a: We start from parts we have built and run before, so a build takes about a day, not weeks. It runs in your own cloud account, so there is nothing for us to bill each month.

items.q: Are we too small for this?
items.a: Maybe. Under about 100 orders a month on two channels, a free app may be enough. We will tell you honestly on the call.
A small team of engineers in Dhaka, Bangladesh: Tausif, Hasib, Jimam, Siam, Maha and Shohan. You talk to the people who build it.
